biography.plain_text: Stephen Sidwell is a Canadian entrepreneur from Vancouver whose ventures span investment banking, food and building materials. He founded Devante Capital and Luvo, and co-founded LYFE Kitchen and Nexii. Sales of three businesses enabled an early retirement before he returned to develop lower-carbon construction products through Nexii, later leaving its leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Stephen Sidwell's food ventures began with a personal effort to eat better. He hired nutrition specialist Stephen Ford to prepare meals that would help him lose weight. Ford's cooking suggested a wider business opportunity: convenient meals could be built around whole foods without asking customers to give up familiar flavours.

At Luvo, Sidwell sought to change the experience of buying a frozen dinner. Meals cooked inside parchment pouches, allowing ingredients to steam before being served on a plate. Herbs and spices provided flavour while limiting reliance on salt. Luvo meals were served on Delta Air Lines flights. The company also planned bistros and kiosks in universities, hospitals and workplaces.

confidence.reason: Primary collaborator biography supports personal trigger; full trade interview supports cooking, flavour and distribution choices. Planned outlets explicitly distinguished from completed ones.
